t: The Absolute Path to Unsilencing Subprocess Failures in AI Workflows
s: This technical article details debugging a silent subprocess failure in an AI workflow caused by relative path ambiguity. The resolution involved implementing absolute path calculations, highlighting the importance of disciplined pursuit of stability for robust automated AI systems.
